> Cyprian Ocharo is a Kenya-based Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specializing in building modern web applications, production-grade cloud management systems, and high-performance digital platforms using Next.js 15, React 19, Laravel 11, PHP 8.4, and Tailwind CSS. ## Flagship Systems & Featured Projects

### 1. SkolarTrak SIS & E-Library (https://skolartrak.com)
- **Role:** Lead Full-Stack Architect & Developer
- **Type:** Multi-tenant Student Information System (SIS) & CBC Digital E-Library
- **Target Market:** Primary Schools & Junior Secondary Schools (JSS) implementing Kenya's Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC)
- **Stack:** PHP 8.4, Laravel 11, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Safaricom M-Pesa STK Push via IntaSend, Advanta Africa Bulk SMS
- **Core Features:**
  - Automated 4-rubric CBC evaluation engine (EE, ME, AE, BE)
  - Dynamic student fee ledgers with real-time M-Pesa STK Push webhook reconciliation
  - Automated report card PDF generation with attendance and teacher evaluation remarks
  - 4-tier Role-Based Access Control: System Admin (`/system-hq`), Teachers (`/teacher-hub`), Secretary (`/secretary-hub`), and Parents (`/my-portal`)
  - SkolarTrak CBC digital e-library with past papers, study notes, and AI-assisted revision guides

### 2. DreamRoots Kenya Consultancy (https://dreamrootskenya.com / https://dreamroots.vercel.app)
- **Role:** Web Architect & Full-Stack Developer
- **Type:** Strategic Management & Corporate Advisory Web Platform
- **Stack:** React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Swiper
- **Core Features:**
  - Responsive executive institutional layout showcasing advisory services (Management, HR, ICT, Education, Research)
  - Dynamic client consultation booking workflows
  - Optimized Core Web Vitals and search visibility

### 3. SafariTrak
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Type:** Real-time East African Traveler Safety & Journey Tracking Web App
- **Stack:** PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, Leaflet Maps, Tailwind CSS
- **Core Features:** Interactive trip monitoring, trusted contact emergency alerts, safety check-ins

### 4. Interactive Developer Portfolio
- **URL:** https://cyprian-portfolio.vercel.app
- **Stack:** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI
